Frequently asked questions

What should I caption a Christmas photo dump?

+

One short line that sets the mood: cozy, funny or nostalgic. Let the photos show the tree, the food and the people; the caption only needs to frame them.

When should I post a holiday photo dump?

+

Whenever your photos are ready. Many people post on the evening itself or the day after, or save everything for one December recap at the end of the month.

Should I post one dump for Christmas and another for New Year's?

+

If you have enough photos for both, two smaller dumps are easier to swipe than one long one. Otherwise a single December recap covers everything.

Can I use these captions for free?

+

Yes. Every caption on this page is original writing and free to copy, edit and post. No credit needed.
